review_text: The acting was phenomenal, truly Oscar-worthy performance.
CGI looked fake and took me out of the movie.
The pacing was so slow, I almost fell asleep halfway through.
Great acting but the plot had holes you could drive a truck through.
Movie dragged on forever, needed much tighter editing.
Cinematography was stunning, every frame could be a painting.
The dialogue felt unnatural and forced, nobody talks like that.
Soundtrack was forgettable, didn't add anything to the experience.
The director's vision really shone through in every scene.
The tempo was completely wrong for what should have been an action film.
Lead actor carried the entire movie on his shoulders.
Visual effects were groundbreaking, never seen anything like it.
Story was predictable and boring, saw the ending coming a mile away.
Another movie ruined by painfully slow pacing.
Acting was wooden and unconvincing, felt like reading lines.
The film's rhythm was perfectly balanced, flowed beautifully.
Explosions looked cheap and unconvincing, low budget feel.
Plot twists were genuinely surprising, kept me on edge.
Felt like a 3-hour film crammed into 90 minutes, too rushed.
Supporting cast stole every scene they were in.
